name: arXiv Assistant
author: Pierre Cagne
description: The latest arXiv preprints of your categories in the bar, and AI reading reports on the ones you star, written for your own expertise.

barWidget.description: Browse the newest preprints of a few arXiv categories; star papers to get reading reports from Claude Code, Codex or another AI.

schema.label: arXiv categories
schema.description: Comma-separated category codes; each one gets a tab, e.g. math.CT, cs.LO, hep-th.

schema.label: Report folder
schema.description: Where the Markdown reports for starred preprints are written.

schema.label: Who the reports are for
schema.description: Your expertise, as the report should assume it, e.g. "a working mathematician in categorical logic and type theory" or "an ML engineer who builds retrieval systems". Empty: a researcher in the paper's own field.

schema.label: Report style
schema.description: Theory: theorems, definitions and proof strategies. Empirical: claims, methods, evaluation and reproducibility. Auto adapts to the paper. Custom uses your own prompt file.

schema.label: Custom prompt file
schema.description: Markdown prompt used when the report style is Custom. Placeholders: {READER}, {SOURCE}, {SOURCE_NOTE}.

schema.label: AI engine
schema.description: Claude Code and Codex read the paper's files themselves. A custom command gets the paper's text with the prompt on standard input and must print Markdown.

schema.label: Model
schema.description: Passed to Claude Code (--model) or Codex (-m), e.g. "opus" or "gpt-5". Empty: the engine's default.

schema.label: Custom command
schema.description: Used when the engine is Custom command, e.g. "llm -m gpt-4.1" or "ollama run qwen3". Runs with your permissions; the sandbox does not apply to it.

schema.label: Sandbox the AI to the paper
schema.description: On: Claude Code and Codex can read only the paper's folder and the extra folders below. Off: they can read any file you can. They can never write files.

schema.label: Extra folders the AI may read
schema.description: Comma-separated folders, e.g. your own notes or papers, so reports can relate the paper to your work. Read-only.

schema.label: Report viewer port
schema.description: Local port of the report viewer (127.0.0.1 only).
